text_block_list.text:
Can you believe in that which you cannot
see?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're incredibly fast, without a
doubt... I'm going to have to
do better
than this...

That which is only beheld in the eyes of
another?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...So that I can catch up... to my friend...
Who exactly are you?

It's well past dusk when I realize I've
forgotten my phone somewhere.

I probably set it down while focusing on
watching some training
sessions around the
academy today.

I jog back to where I assume I've left the
thing, and am reassuringly
greeted by a
flashing low-battery light.
Hehe...

—s is fun... hehe...
—ow can I... —atch up?

I don't expect to hear anything on the
track at this hour, let alone
laughter. Is
someone really out here training right
now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Phew... Don't worry... I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. However many more times it
takes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I really love... running with you...

There's certainly no one around besides us.
I know that it's quite dark
out, but still.
Thinking it strange, I approach the lone
student, when...
Thwack!

It feels as if something has rammed into my
shoulder. I can't see
anything in the
vicinity, however.

But a girl talking to someone who isn't
there? And then myself
colliding with
some kind of invisible force?

The night air isn't the only thing giving me
the chills... Though it's
probably just my
imagination running wild...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real? I'll gladly take up the
offer! It's always been my
dream to make it
big in a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: For real. Let's turn that dream into reality!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! I've been aiming to debut in the
Twinkle Series this whole
time, so...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I sense you've got what it takes. I'll be
back to watch your tryout race.
Think you
can show me everything you've got?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, <username>!
Looks like you've got your
eyes on
someone.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the girl over there? ...She does run
with mighty fine form. Are you
gonna scout
her?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Really? I've definitely seen her
somewhere, though... Um, maybe in
these
pamphlets, yeah?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Found her—Manhattan Cafe. She's good. If
you're not going to scout
her, then I'm off
to chat to her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You want... to scout me?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If you don't have anyone else in
mind, why don't we aim for the
top of the
Twinkle Series together?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You can outrun anyone else out here for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Anyone else? Hm... Do you think... I could even outrun... her?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
..."Her"? Who? Oh, I'm guessing you have
a rival then?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. She's incredibly fast... That girl
standing right over there...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: O-over there? But there's no one th—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She looks like me... She's the one who led
me here. My dear friend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't changed since we were
children... Always running ahead of
me... I
dream of... reaching her...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Save your breath. Don't think she's looking to really talk to anyone, let alone be scouted.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't make heads or tails of anything
she was babbling about... It
was like she
was trying to drive me off. And honestly,
the things she
was saying were kind of,
uh...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Kind of creepy?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'm just saying that maybe you shouldn't
bother. She seems to be
more trouble than
anything...
I'm reminded of what happened last night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. However many more times it
takes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I really love... running with you...

I chalk up all that happened last night to
my imagination, but perhaps
there is
something more at play here.

Does she really not have any interest in
being scouted?

My mind drifts, pondering the mysterious
Manhattan Cafe. Next thing
I know, the
sky has darkened into a murky night...
